revenue.source: Sales to customers, JNJ FY2025 10-K (accession 0000200406-26-000016) / app.edgar.tools/companies/JNJ

operating_income.source: Derived: pretax earnings (15,062/16,687/32,581) + interest expense (772/755/971) - interest income (1,261/1,332/1,056) + other (income) expense, net (6,634/4,694/-7,209); J&J reports no operating income line, so non-operating other items (incl. litigation charges, FY2025 gains) are excluded. Inputs from app.edgar.tools/companies/JNJ and FY2025 10-K.

d_and_a.source: Depreciation and amortization of property and intangibles, cash flow statement, app.edgar.tools/companies/JNJ (FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 10-K)

capex.source: Additions to property, plant and equipment, cash flow statement, app.edgar.tools/companies/JNJ; FY2025 4,832 confirmed in JNJ 2025 Annual Report (FCF 24,530-4,832... = 19,698)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 6.0% (94,193 vs 88,821); FY2024 4.3%. Fade from ~5.5% toward 4% as large products (Stelara) face LOE/biosimilar pressure, offset by pipeline and MedTech growth. Not company guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: derived FY2025 margin 26.8% (25,287/94,193), FY2024 23.4%, FY2023 24.9%; held ~27% on operating leverage, offset by R&D and amortization of acquisitions.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. J&J historical effective tax rate mid-teens to ~17% (e.g. 17.8% H1 2025 per Q2 2025 release); rounded to 16%, with Pillar Two upside risk.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 4,832/94,193 = 5.1%; FY2024 5.0%; modest rise for US manufacturing investment.

wacc.source: Assumption: low-beta (~0.5-0.6) mega-cap pharma/medtech, rf ~4.3%, ERP ~5%, AAA credit with ~10% debt weight; WACC approx 7-7.5%. Not computed from a data provider.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP/inflation-ish growth, below WACC; healthcare demand supports 2-3%.

net_debt.source: JNJ FY2025 10-K (accession 0000200406-26-000016), MD&A: net debt (debt less cash and current marketable securities) of $27.8bn at Dec 28, 2025 (debt $47.9bn, cash $19.7bn)

diluted_shares.source: Average shares outstanding diluted FY2025, JNJ FY2025 10-K / Q4 2025 earnings release (millions)
